name: devoxxgenie
description: Natural-language questions about the DevoxxGenie plugin repository, each paired with the repo-relative file(s) whose chunks answer it. A question counts as a hit at rank k when any expected file is among the top k retrieved files. Questions deliberately avoid class names where a developer wouldn't know them, so the benchmark measures semantic retrieval rather than keyword overlap.

questions.question: How does the agent stop itself from calling tools forever, and what happens when the maximum is reached?
How can the agent explore several parts of the codebase at the same time using helper agents?
Does each sub-agent get its own chat memory and model, and which tools is it allowed to use?
How are dangerous shell commands like git reset --hard blocked even when they are hidden inside a compound command?
Which agent tools can run without asking the user for approval?
Where are the descriptions of the built-in tools that the language model actually sees, and can users override them?
How can the model batch several tool calls into one JavaScript script step?
How can the user send an extra instruction to the agent while it is still working, without breaking pending tool calls?
How does the plugin hide MCP server tools that the user switched off in settings?
Where is the user asked to approve an MCP tool call before it runs outside agent mode?
How is the raw JSON-RPC traffic between the plugin and an MCP server captured for the log panel?
Where is each LLM provider mapped to the factory that builds its chat model?
How does the custom OpenAI-compatible provider fetch the list of available models without freezing the IDE when the server is down?
How are results from several paraphrased versions of a search query merged into a single ranking?
When I save a file, how does the semantic index get updated automatically, and why doesn't every keystroke trigger it?
How does indexing know a file is already indexed and skip it, even after a branch switch touched its timestamp?
Why are markdown table separator rows not stored in the vector database?
When RAG is on, when is semantic context injected into the prompt and when is it a tool the agent calls instead?
How is the ChromaDB Docker image pulled and its container started with persistent storage?
What do I need to install before I can use RAG, and which embedding model is required?
How are files listed in .gitignore, including nested ignore files in subfolders, left out of the project scan?
How do CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md instructions from the project root end up in the system prompt?
What does the /init command do and how do I generate a project guidance file for the LLM?
Which web search engines can be used to ground answers with internet results, and how is one chosen?
What usage data does the plugin send, and is any prompt text or code ever included?
Which local servers can provide fill-in-the-middle code completions while I type in the editor?
How do I connect the plugin to my own OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a custom base URL?
How do I add reusable skills that the assistant can load on demand?
